//: Connected mode is opt-in. Copy this file to wwwroot/appsettings.json and set
Api:BaseAddress to a running WorkPlan Studio API to replace the persona
switcher with a real sign-in and run schedules on the server.
It is a sample, not the live file: Blazor loads appsettings.json and
appsettings.{Environment}.json, and no environment is called 'sample', so
this file is never fetched. Leaving appsettings.json absent - which is what
the published GitHub Pages build does - keeps the app fully offline.
Two things to check on the server side once it is configured:
* Cors:AllowedOrigins on the API must list this app's origin;
so an API on plain http on another origin is blocked by the browser.
Use https, or relax that directive for a local experiment only.
